summary_en: Hi-CRATES declared a special dividend of 6.00 yen per share with a record date of September 30, 2026 and an effective date of December 3, 2026. The ordinary dividend of 44.00 yen per share brings the total dividend to 50.00 yen per share. The special dividend commemorates the company's 50th fiscal year and three consecutive years of record earnings.
title_en: Notice Regarding Dividend of Surplus (Special Dividend)
translation_en_brief: Hi-CRATES announced a special dividend of 6.00 yen per share effective December 3, 2026, with a record date of September 30, 2026. The special dividend is in addition to the ordinary dividend of 44.00 yen per share, bringing total dividend per share to 50.00 yen. The company stated that the special dividend commemorates the company's milestone 50th fiscal year and three consecutive years of record earnings in the current fiscal year. The company operates in preventive healthcare focused on AI and voice-integrated electronic health records systems, contributing to addressing issues related to hygienist shortages, extension of healthy life expectancy, and suppression of national medical expenditures.
